name: Sopas
ingredients: 250 g chicken, cut into small pieces
description: Sopas is a popular Filipino comfort food made with macaroni pasta, chicken, vegetables, and a creamy milk-based broth. It is warm, filling, and especially enjoyable during rainy days or as a comforting breakfast or snack.
instructions:
Cook the chicken: Heat the cooking oil in a large pot. Sauté the garlic and onion until fragrant, then add the chicken and cook until lightly browned.
Add the broth: Pour in the water or chicken broth and bring it to a boil. Allow the chicken to cook thoroughly. 
Cook the macaroni: Add the elbow macaroni and cook according to the package instructions. Stir occasionally to prevent the pasta from sticking together. 
Add the vegetables: Add the carrots and cook for a few minutes. Then add the cabbage. 
Make it creamy: Pour in the evaporated milk and gently stir the soup. 
Season and serve: Add salt and pepper according to your taste. Cook for another 2–3 minutes, then serve while hot.

name: Champorado
ingredients: 1 cup evaporated milk or condensed milk
Powdered milk or additional milk for serving(Optional)
A small amount of condensed milk for extra sweetness(Optional)
description: Champorado is a popular Filipino chocolate rice porridge. It is made with glutinous rice, cocoa, sugar, and milk. This sweet and creamy dish is commonly served for breakfast or as a snack and can be enjoyed warm or cold.
instructions:
Wash the rice: Rinse the glutinous rice thoroughly with water. 
Cook the rice: Place the rice and water in a pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and cook until the rice becomes soft. 
Add the cocoa: Mix the cocoa powder with a small amount of water to form a smooth mixture. Add it to the cooked rice and stir well. 
Add the sugar: Add the sugar and continue stirring until it completely dissolves.
Cook until thick: Allow the champorado to simmer for a few more minutes until it reaches a thick and creamy consistency. 
Serve: Transfer the champorado to a bowl and pour milk on top. Add more sugar or condensed milk if desired.

name: Lugaw
ingredients: 1 cup glutinous rice or regular rice
description: Lugaw is a popular Filipino rice porridge made by slowly cooking rice in water or broth until it becomes soft and creamy. It is a warm and comforting dish, often enjoyed for breakfast, during rainy days, or when someone is feeling unwell.
instructions:
Prepare the ingredients: Wash the rice thoroughly with clean water. 
Sauté the aromatics: Heat the cooking oil in a large pot. Sauté the garlic and onion until fragrant. 
Add the rice: Add the washed rice and stir for about a minute. 
Add the liquid: Pour in the water or chicken broth and bring it to a boil. 
Cook the lugaw: Reduce the heat and allow the mixture to simmer. Stir occasionally to prevent the rice from sticking to the bottom of the pot. 
Wait until creamy: Continue cooking until the rice becomes soft and the mixture reaches a thick, creamy consistency. Add more water if necessary. 
Season and serve: Add salt and pepper according to your taste. Serve in a bowl and add your preferred toppings.

name: Miki
ingredients: 250 g chicken, cut into small pieces
description: Miki is a popular Filipino noodle dish made with soft, thick egg noodles served in a flavorful broth with chicken or pork and vegetables. It is a warm and filling meal that can be enjoyed for breakfast, lunch, or during rainy days.
instructions:
Prepare the chicken: Heat the cooking oil in a large pot and sauté the garlic and onion until fragrant. 
Cook the chicken: Add the chicken and cook until it is lightly browned. 
Add the broth: Pour in the chicken broth or water. Add the soy sauce and bring the mixture to a boil. 
Cook the vegetables: Add the carrots and cook for a few minutes. Then, add the cabbage. 
Add the noodles: Add the fresh miki noodles and cook according to the package instructions or until the noodles are soft. 
Season the dish: Add salt and pepper according to your taste. Serve: Transfer the miki into a bowl and garnish with chopped green onions.

name: Bihon
ingredients: 200 g chicken, cut into small pieces
1 medium carrot, cut into thin strips
description: Pancit Bihon is a popular Filipino noodle dish made with thin rice noodles, meat, and a variety of vegetables. It is flavorful, filling, and commonly served during celebrations, family gatherings, or as an everyday meal.
instructions:
Soak the bihon: Place the rice noodles in water for about 10 minutes or until slightly softened. Drain and set aside. 
Sauté the ingredients: Heat the cooking oil in a large pan or wok. Sauté the garlic and onion until fragrant. 
Cook the chicken: Add the chicken and cook until it is lightly browned and fully cooked. 
Add the vegetables: Add the carrots and green beans. Cook for a few minutes before adding the cabbage. 
Add the seasoning: Pour in the chicken broth and soy sauce. Allow the mixture to simmer for a few minutes. 
Cook the noodles: Add the soaked bihon noodles. Gently mix everything together until the noodles absorb the broth and become soft. 
Season and serve: Add salt and pepper according to your taste. Serve on a plate with calamansi or lemon on the side.

name: Tapsilog
ingredients: 1 tablespoon calamansi juice or lemon juice
description: Tapsilog is a popular Filipino breakfast meal consisting of tapa (marinated beef), sinangag (garlic fried rice), and itlog (fried egg). Its name comes from combining the words tapa, sinangag, and itlog. It is a flavorful and filling meal commonly enjoyed for breakfast.
instructions:
In a bowl, combine the beef, soy sauce, brown sugar, minced garlic, and calamansi juice. Mix well and allow it to marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat cooking oil in a pan. Add the marinated beef and cook until the meat is fully cooked and slightly caramelized. Set aside.
Heat oil in another pan and sauté the minced garlic until golden and fragrant. Add the cooked rice and mix well. Season with a little salt and cook for several minutes.
Heat a small amount of oil in a pan and fry the eggs according to your preferred level of doneness. Season with salt and pepper.
Place the garlic fried rice, beef tapa, and fried egg together on a plate.

name: Hotsilog
description: Hotsilog is a popular Filipino breakfast meal consisting of hotdogs, sinangag (garlic fried rice), and itlog (fried egg). Its name combines the words hotdog, sinangag, and itlog. It is a simple, flavorful, and filling meal that is especially popular among Filipino families.
instructions:
Heat a pan over medium heat and add a small amount of cooking oil. Add the hotdogs and cook until heated through and lightly browned. You may add a little water and cover the pan to help cook them evenly.
Heat the oil in another pan and sauté the minced garlic until golden and fragrant. Add the cooked rice and mix well. Season with a little salt and cook for several minutes.
Heat a small amount of oil in a pan. Crack the eggs into the pan and cook according to your preferred level of doneness. Season with salt and pepper.
Place the garlic fried rice, cooked hotdogs, and fried egg together on a plate.

name: Longsilog
description: Longsilog is a popular Filipino breakfast meal consisting of longganisa (Filipino sausage), sinangag (garlic fried rice), and itlog (fried egg). Its name comes from combining the words longganisa, sinangag, and itlog. The sweet and savory flavor of longganisa makes this a delicious and filling breakfast meal.
instructions:
Place the longganisa and water in a pan over medium heat. Cover and allow the longganisa to cook until the water evaporates. Add a small amount of cooking oil and fry the longganisa until browned.
Heat the cooking oil in a pan and sauté the minced garlic until golden and fragrant. Add the cooked rice and mix well. Season with a little salt and cook for several minutes.
Heat a small amount of cooking oil in a pan. Crack the eggs into the pan and cook according to your preferred level of doneness. Season with salt and pepper.
Place the garlic fried rice, cooked longganisa, and fried egg together on a plate.

name: Tosilog
description: Tosilog is a popular Filipino breakfast meal consisting of tocino (sweet cured pork), sinangag (garlic fried rice), and itlog (fried egg). Its name comes from combining the words tocino, sinangag, and itlog. The sweet and savory tocino perfectly complements the flavorful garlic rice and egg.
instructions:
Place the tocino and water in a pan over medium heat. Cover the pan and allow the tocino to cook until the water has mostly evaporated. Add a small amount of cooking oil and continue cooking until the tocino is browned and slightly caramelized.
Heat the cooking oil in a separate pan. Sauté the minced garlic until golden and fragrant. Add the cooked rice and mix well. Season with a little salt and cook for several minutes.
Heat a small amount of cooking oil in a pan. Crack the eggs into the pan and cook according to your preferred level of doneness. Season with salt and pepper.
Arrange the garlic fried rice, cooked tocino, and fried egg together on a plate.

name: Cornsilog
description: Cornsilog is a Filipino-style breakfast meal consisting of corned beef, sinangag (garlic fried rice), and itlog (fried egg). Its name combines the words corned beef, sinangag, and itlog. It is a savory, flavorful, and filling meal that is easy to prepare.
instructions:
Heat the cooking oil in a pan and sauté the sliced onion until soft. Add the corned beef and stir well. Add a small amount of water if desired and cook for approximately 5–7 minutes.
Heat the oil in another pan and sauté the minced garlic until golden and fragrant. Add the cooked rice and mix well. Season with a little salt and cook for several minutes.
Heat a small amount of cooking oil in a pan. Crack the eggs into the pan and cook according to your preferred level of doneness. Season with salt and pepper.
Place the garlic fried rice, corned beef, and fried egg together on a plate.
